title: How to Evaluate When You Don't Know How to Evaluate? Choosing Reliable Setups for Base Language Model Benchmarking

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: To identify effective evaluation setups, we investigate 8 aspects, such as task formulation or the number of in-context examples.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We compare the setups using three widely-used signal criteria, repurposed as normative meta-measures: monotonicity, non-randomness, and ranking consistency of the evaluation scores across intermediate checkpoints.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: In an early pretraining scenario, we evaluate these setups on 26 monolingual 2B-parameter models trained on different types of data, using 80 tasks in four languages.
